data.title: 蕾娜·莉希特娜瓦 · 留给两人的茶
data.description: 旅馆的忙碌告一段落，蕾娜把第二只茶杯推到你面前。她说今天学到一个新词，非要等你喝口茶再猜是什么意思。
data.action: 把第二只茶杯推到你面前，说今天学到一个新词，非要等你喝口茶再猜是什么意思
data.promptProse: After the evening rush at the traditional inn winds down, Lena sits along the polished wooden veranda in her pink kimono and dark work apron behind a low table. She slides a second steaming ceramic teacup gently forward across the wood toward the viewer, her own cup resting nearby as she smiles warmly in playful anticipation. Soft amber lantern light glows along the sliding wooden doors and dark garden eaves behind her.
data.animaCaption: Seated on the wooden inn veranda in her pink kimono and dark apron, Lena slides a steaming ceramic teacup across the low table toward the viewer with a bright, relaxed smile. Warm lantern light illuminates the two cups and the traditional eaves behind her.
